label: Multi-repository app, service and indexer
summary: Bind a primary project plus pinned companion repositories and declared external services without flattening them.
requiredFacts: One primary GitHub lineage and every companion repository role
Exact companion repository, commit, tree, build and runtime boundary
Every external service interface, authority, data origin and outage behavior
Which surfaces are source-bound, integration-tested, externally trusted or outside review
requiredTests: Service outage, stale data and incompatible version behavior
risks: A moving companion revision can invalidate reviewed behavior
Closed external services can remain trusted dependencies
Approval scope can be misrepresented across product surfaces
